nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Solution

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report mixed results, with one describing new whiteheads and stickiness/poor absorption and another finding it smooth, thin and fast-drying with a pleasant smell.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report that the serum does not dry out or feel sticky on their skin and several note it feels moisturizing, with some also seeing spots lighten.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive skin mostly report no irritation or burning, though one advises a patch test after experiencing some irritation and another with fragrance-sensitivity noted the scent did not bother her.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s-50s with sun damage or age spots report gradual lightening of spots and brighter, healthier-looking tone with consistent use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers addressing sun damage and age spots report gradual lightening and brighter tone after several weeks of consistent use, with results described as slow but visible.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report the serum feels hydrating and does not dry out or pill, though one recommends waiting a few minutes before moisturizer to avoid pilling.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer used it successfully alongside tretinoin without added irritation, and a few sensitive-skin users report no burning or reactivity, but one reviewer experienced skin irritation and recommends a patch test.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers who used it for several weeks to a month report visible fading of dark spots, sun spots, or melasma, though a notable minority (including a full-bottle user) report no visible change at all and a melasma sufferer specifically found it ineffective for that concern.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report acne scars or dark marks fading with continued use, but two describe new breakouts or whiteheads appearing after starting the product, particularly on oily or acne-prone skin.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin found the texture too tacky and slow to absorb and reported new clogging-type bumps, while another described it as thin, non-sticky and fast-absorbing despite oily skin.

aspects.libelle: Results require weeks of consistent use
Layers well under makeup and moisturizer

extraits.titre: Not bad, but not for oily skin
extraits.texte: I've been using this serum for about 2-3 weeks now so I could get a real feel for it. Honestly, I haven't noticed much of a difference in my skin. I have some acne scars and discoloration in my face and I haven't seen any of that fade. I have noticed a few new little white heads in places I don't normally get them, so I think this formula may be causing those. I have quite oily skin so anything clogging or heavy will cause a reaction. I let it sit for about 5-10 minutes before applying moisturizer and the serum is still sticky/tacky on my skin. So I don't feel It really sinks in very well to my skin type. The smell is pretty strong, but not harsh. Smells like lavender, very natural. My eyes and nose are very sensitive to strong smells and this serum did not affect me negatively. Overall, I would not repurchase personally for my skin type.

Great smell and feel on skin, however after using the whole bottle I saw no difference in my spots. I have melasma and I know it's difficult to treat, but I was willing to spend the money to try this. I wouldn't recommend this for melasma, not sure about other sun damage.

extraits.titre: Finally a potent vitamin c for dry skin!
extraits.texte: Finally, a strong vitamin c that doesn't irritate my dry skin. My husband and I have both been using this product consistently for 2 to 2.5 weeks once every other day (daytime application). Although this isn't much time I like to give an honest review after a month. Application: very smooth Application, its not sticky or tacky and I can say I CAN apply it underneath makeup which is a huge plus for me..within this short time of using the product he noticed his dark spots slightly fading along with same small acne spots that faded. Also, he is extremely sensitive to strong scents and cant stand anything with a strong scent this product doesnt bother him at all he said he could do without the scent all together but it didn't bother him all that much.I noticed a difference in the texture of my skin, my acne scaring faded very slightly but I noticed , and I'm not sure how but somehow this product was slightly moisturizing for my DRY skin which is VERYYYY surprising because most ingredients in this product would dry me out.. especially salicylic acid and vitamin c. I am very happy with my results so far, and I am definitely looking forward to continuing to use it. (I did receive this product from Bzz Agent, but please understand I would never mislead anyone I always give my honest opinion).

[received free product for honest review] been really loving this product for about a week now! I've always loved Kiehl's brand but had never tried a dark spot correction since I'm only 31, but I wish I had started it sooner. My sensitive skin has been loving this with no problems and I swear already looks more even with the lighter sun spots I do have on my cheeks! I really love the way it applies on my face and dries down so quick and nicely with only very very minimal "stickiness" to it. Once I add my moisturizer after a few minutes I truly don't even feel it on my face and head to bed. The amount you get in the bottle is great and a little goes a long way, since I only use it at night this will last me a few months for sure. Can't wait to keep using this and see what results I have in even just another couple weeks ☺️

extraits.titre: Love how it feels on my skin!
extraits.texte: I have been using Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Solution for about 2 weeks. I love how it feels when putting it on my face. It's smooth, not sticky, and makes my face feel hydrated. I am almost 50yrs old with sun damaged skin/age spots and while they didn't disappear they've definitely lightened. I've also noticed that the overall tone of my skin looks brighter and healthier. Using a few drops when applying the solution goes a long way so this bottle will also last a long time. I will be continuing to use this solution and highly recommend it.

This stuff is great! I noticed a reduction in the dark spots on my chin from acne flareups in about two weeks of using the serum. I have very dry, sensitive skin and I did not experience any sensitivity with this. The texture is very light and not sticky at all. It absorbs almost instantly! I really love this product and would likely re-order

I received this product free in exchange for my unbiased review. I've only used this for a couple of weeks so far, but believe that I'll see more results with long term use. That being said, the packaging is nice. The product comes in a glass bottle with a dropper to dispense the product. It has a very subtle scent. I would recommend that persons with sensitive skin do a spot test before using in a full dosage as it did cause some skin irritation for me. Love the Kiehl's brand and would purchase
